verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs pitch for_each-generated provider configurations as 'perfect for... multi-environment setups (dev/staging/prod)', so it documents a multi-environment mechanism. That mechanism works inside a single configuration, though; nothing in the pack documents isolating environments as separate stacks or workspaces. Missing for 10: documented workspace commands (e.g. creating and selecting workspaces), per-environment state isolation, per-environment variable files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
